Supreme Court Halts Rahul Gandhi Asset Case Proceedings, Addresses Other Complaints

The Supreme Court has halted proceedings in a disproportionate assets case against Rahul Gandhi, directing the Allahabad High Court to defer its own actions. The court also issued notices regarding the case. Separately, Delhi Police are investigating a complaint seeking an FIR against Sonia and Rahul Gandhi for alleged "anti-national" activities related to a "Vande Mataram" incident. Another outlet reported a lawyers' strike postponed a hearing in a defamation case against Rahul Gandhi.
